parity_reason: The scores differ by at most 1 on every criterion (only craft differs), the totals are 23 vs 22 (a difference of 1), and neither image has a critical defect, so all three parity conditions hold.

reference.summary: A white pelican with a large orange pouch rides a red bicycle in a sunny landscape, with its feet on the pedals and its wing reaching the handlebars; it answers the prompt clearly and cleanly.

defects.what: There is no saddle or seat post, so the body floats on the top tube instead of sitting on a seat
defects.where: between the pelican's body and the bicycle frame
defects.expected: The pelican visibly sits on a saddle attached to the frame

defects.what: The legs are thin straight sticks that bend stiffly and do not clearly match the positions of the crank arms
defects.where: the pelican's legs and the pedals
defects.expected: The legs bend naturally, with each foot clearly placed on its own pedal at opposite points of the crank

defects.what: The wing tip overlaps the handlebar grip, so it is unclear whether the wing holds the bar or passes over it
defects.where: the front tip of the wing at the handlebars
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly grips or rests on the handlebar

attempt.summary: A pelican with a big pouched beak rides a red bicycle on a green hill under a sun, with its feet on the pedals; it is clear and on prompt but less polished.

defects.what: The wheels have only a few uneven spokes, set at irregular angles, so they look unfinished
defects.expected: Each wheel has evenly spaced spokes running all the way around the hub

defects.what: The neck has no outline while the head and body do, and its pale colour almost disappears against the light sky
defects.expected: The neck is drawn in the same outlined style as the body and stands out clearly from the background

defects.what: There is no saddle, so the pelican's body rests directly on the frame tubes
defects.expected: The pelican visibly sits on a saddle mounted on the frame

defects.what: The legs are very thin and angular, and the upper foot only barely meets its pedal
defects.expected: Both feet rest clearly on the pedals, with legs in proportion to the body
